book.name: Matiu
book.title: Cau Amsǝban a nê mala MATIU

content: Aɓwana alta gir'lǝmdǝaa ban Yesu
Amǝ Farisi andǝ amǝ Saduki yiu a ban Yesu à nǝ̀ kārǝki. À zǝmbi wi ama ɓǝ̀ lǝmdǝia wia ɓekǝ gir'ndali mana nǝ̀ lǝmdǝ ama yì ka, pur nǝban Ɓakuli.
Yesu pǝlǝia wia ama:

content.text: Nǝ pwarikpǝra ka ɓǝ̀ wu sǝn kùli bang ngga wu kǝ na ama, <<Ban no nǝ̀ ɓoaro.>>
Sǝ nǝ budǝmbari ɓǝ̀ wu sǝn kùli bangŋa sǝ ban pǝndǝ ka, wu na ama, <<Mbulo no nǝ̀ nya yalung.>> Wu kǝ gandǝ bang ɓá pa mala bumkuli, sǝ agir mana à kǝ lǝmdǝ pa mala nza man ngga wu bwaltea ɗàng.
Nza mala amǝ'ɓealɓikea andǝ amǝ'ɗwanyi ɓanggi Ɓakuli na à alkiyita gìr mana à nǝ̀ sǝn ngga. Sǝ à pà nǝ̀ lǝmdǝia ɓekǝ gir'lǝmdǝa ɗang, shekǝ mala Yunana.

content: Yesu pǝlǝa nyia o.
Yist mala amǝ Farisiandǝ amǝ Saduki
Lang alaggana mala Yesu eauwe a ɓè nkaring nggeamùr ka, à sǝni ka ɓalǝia lorǝo à twal bǝredi a buia ɗàng.
Yesu nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Wu par kir wun, wu yál ɓamur rǝ wun arǝ yist mala amǝ Farisi andǝ amǝ Saduki.>>

content: Pǝlǝa alaggana male kùtí a nacau arǝarǝia ama, <<Bang anggo acemǝnana sǝm yiu nǝ bǝredi raka.>>
Yesu yi sǝlǝia wia nǝ cau mǝno à nakiyi ka sǝ ɗia ama,

content.text: <<Palang sǝ wu kǝ nacau arǝarǝ wun amur ɗwanyi bǝredi? Gūliarǝu ma'wun kyau fat!
Wun ado ka wu kǝ gandǝ bwalta cau mbo? Ɓalǝ wun lorǝna ce abǝredi tongno mǝnana ǝn linǝ aɓwana á-tongno nǝi ka? Azace shen sǝ wu lùmsǝia nǝ aɓwangine?
Sǝ lang arǝ abǝredi tongno-nong-ɓari mǝnana ǝn linǝ aɓwana á-ine nǝi ka? Azace shen sǝ wu lùmsǝia nǝ aɓwangine mǝnana a ueo ka?
Palang sǝ wu gandǝ sǝlǝ ama ǝn pa arǝ nacau amur bǝredi raka? Mǝ nda arǝ na ama wu par kir wun ce wu earnǝ yist mala amǝ Farisi andǝ amǝ Saduki ɗang.>>

content: Nda sǝ cê kpania wia ama pa arǝ nunkiria amur yist mana à tsǝkiyi arǝ bǝredi ka ɗàng. Nda arǝ nacau amur kanigir nyir mala amǝ Farisi andǝ amǝ Saduki.
Bitǝrus bang amaYesu nda Kǝrǝsti
Lang Yesu yina a nzali Kaisariya Filipi ka, ɗì alaggana male ama,

content.text: <<Yana ɗe aɓwana kǝ na ama nda mim Muna mala Ɓwa?>>

content: Sǝ à pa eare ama, <<Aɓea aɓwana kǝ na ama a nda Yohana Mǝbatisǝma; aɓea ka à kǝ na ama, Iliya; sǝ aɓea gbal ka ama Irimiya ko mwashat aɓalǝ amǝ'ɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli.>>
Pǝlǝa Yesu ɗia ma,

content.text: <<Sǝ wun ngga, wu kǝ na ama mǝ nda yan?>>

content: Shiman Bitǝrus pa eare ama, <<A nda Kǝrǝsti, Muna mala Ɓakuli mǝyilǝmuì.>>
Yesu ne wi ama:

content.text: Tsǝkbu na muro, we Shiman muna mala Yunana, acemǝnana súrǝè mala ɓwapǝndǝa na lǝmdǝo mǝnia yì gìr ka ɗàng. Tárrám mǝnana a kùli ka nda.
Sǝ we Bitǝrus ka a nda tali, sǝ amur tali mǝnia ka mǝ nǝ ɓak Ikǝlisiya mem, sǝ rǝcandǝa mala Lú pa nǝ̀ gandǝi ɗàng.
Mǝ nǝ po akyî mala Domurǝm mǝnana a kùli ka; gìr mǝnana kat à kùrrì a ɓanza ka, anggo sǝ à nǝ̀ kùrrì a kùli, sǝ gìr mǝnana kat a panzǝi a ɓanza ka, anggo sǝ à nǝ̀ panzǝi a kùli.

content: Pǝlǝa nunkir alaggana male ama ɓǝa kǝa ne kǝɓwa ama yì nda Kǝrǝsti ɗàng.
Yesu bang cau amur lú male
Twal a pwari mǝno ka Yesu tita mǝngì alaggana male ɓá cau ama,

content.text: <<Dumǝna púp mǝ nǝ ká a Urǝshalima, mǝ nǝ ká nu tanni kǝ̀rkǝ́r a bu aɓwana-mǝgule, agbani pǝris andǝ amǝkani nggurcau. À nǝ̀ wal-luem, sǝama a tàruià nongŋo ka mǝ nǝ loapi ɓembe nǝ yilǝmu.>>

content: Bitǝrus pǝlǝa tunǝi zak sǝ pǝrki nǝ ce a kúni ama, <<Pà nǝ̀ pàk ɗàng, Mǝtalabangŋo. Kǝgìr pà nǝ̀ kúmǒ anggo ɗàng!>>
Yesu pǝlǝa arǝ Bitǝrus sǝ ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Nyàrâm anggo, Shetan! A kǝ earce tsǝem mǝ annda, acemǝnana ɗenyicau mo ka mala Ɓakuli na ɗang, mala ɓwapǝndǝa na.>>

content: Pǝlǝa Yesu banggi alaggana male ama:

content.text: Ɓwa mǝnana kat earce ama nǝ̀ yiu atàm nǝ̀ duk mǝkpatam ngga, dumǝna púp nǝ̀ nying ɗenyicau ɓamúrì, nǝ̀ twal nggun-gangndǝi male sǝ nǝ̀ kpatam.
Ɓwa mana kat kǝ sǝni nǝ̀ amsǝ yilǝmi ka nǝ̀ nggá ɗwanyibanì, sǝ ɓwa mǝnana kǝ turta yilǝmi acem ngga, nǝ̀ nggá kumi.

Ɓǝ̀ ɓwa kum koya gìr a ɓanza man kat, sǝ ɗwanyi yilǝmu mǝnana málá male pà kàm raka, lǝmdǝ ama pà nǝ́ kǝgìr ɗàng. Sǝ ɓǝ̀ ɗwanyini yilǝmu mǝnana málá male pà kàm raka, pà nǝ́ kǝgìr mǝnana nǝ̀ pa sǝ nǝ̀ kumi ɗǝm ngga ɗàng.
Acemǝnana Muna mala Ɓwa ka nǝ̀ nggá yiu aɓa gulo mala Tárrí, andǝ amǝturonjar male atè, sǝ nǝ̀ yia pè koyan ngga tangnakusǝi, ace gìr mǝnana pàk ka.
Ən nggǝ na wun aɓa mǝsǝcau ama, aɓea ɓwana na kani aban came mǝnana à pà nǝ̀ wù ɗàng sheɓǝ̀ à sǝna yiu mala Muna mala Ɓwa a Domurǝm male ka.

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Mat 14:1,2; Mar 6:14,15; Luk 9:7,8.
